text:
nina: heads-up from support — customer 312 says lots of traffic billed to org account after the midnight deploy. looks like SA claim was stripped during auth routing.
omar: which deploy? any rollout notes?
nina: auth-router v3.0 rolled at 00:07Z. logs show requests with `x-origin: org/312` but we received `x-initial-origin: org/312/project/7/sa/scheduler` at the edge.
lucy: this is the new claim-collapse behavior on introspect timeout. we did that intentionally but didn't think about billing.
ops-bot: auth-router v3.0 deployed 2025-11-06T00:05Z -> rollout 100% 00:10Z.
billing: org/312 token usage +15% vs project/7 -15%. small $ but customer noticed.
omar: quick mitigations? revert? preserve original header and add an uncertainty flag?
nina: prefer preserve+flag: `x-origin-preserved` + `x-origin-asserted: false` so billing/console can decide. don't let downstream use preserved header for auth unless signed.
lucy: agree. also add telemetry `auth.origin_resolution=introspect_timeout_collapsed` so dashboards can filter.
devex: console UX: add badge "attribution uncertain" on project page and a per-account toggle "reject uncertain attribution" that blocks traffic returning 403.
ops-bot: suggested rollout: quick patch to preserve header -> staging smoke -> 3% canary -> 100% if no billing anomalies.
omar: security: signed preserved header (HMAC) or CIDR-only acceptance. I'll add signature and key rotation plan.
billing: we'll add `billing.attribution_uncertain_count` metric and run a backfill for the midnight window. finance wants manual review before invoice adjustments.
nina: I'll open the PR with tests to ensure preserved header can't be used for auth without signature. ping infra for CIDR and signing keys.
lucy: thanks, also add an e2e that simulates introspect 504 and validates console shows uncertain badge.
